title: EditLattice: code, data and results for exact attribution of self-improving language-model agents through variational replay
description: Code, registered analysis plan, decision log and every result file behind the paper "Which self-made edits matter? Exact attribution for self-improving language-model agents through variational replay". The scripts regenerate every number, table and figure of the paper from the stored results.
